answer: A gambling licence tenure with regulator audits works as the gate: a licence audited by one regulator every year. Each of 243 aliases needs its own licence tenures, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The basalt check runs in the open: 243 fakes pay the full price 243 times, one honest agent pays once, and the lagoon trail in the ledger makes the river cost visible to everyone.
